name: Kubernetes - Enumerate API and Kubelet
description: Probe the K8s API server (6443) for anonymous access and the Kubelet API (10250) for the pod list. kubeletctl streamlines listing pods and finding those that allow command execution.

defense.why_it_works: Kubernetes clusters often expose the Kubelet API (port 10250) without authentication. Anonymous access to the API server or an unauthenticated Kubelet allows listing pods, executing commands, and extracting service account tokens. kubeletctl automates this enumeration without requiring cluster admin credentials.
defense.prerequisites: Network access to Kubernetes control plane ports (6443, 10250). Unauthenticated or weakly authenticated Kubelet API. kubeletctl tool.
defense.impact: Pod listing reveals workload inventory. RCE scanning identifies pods where commands can be executed. Service account token extraction provides Kubernetes API credentials for further lateral movement and privilege escalation within the cluster.
defense.detection: Unusual API server requests from non-cluster IPs to port 6443/10250. Anonymous auth attempts to Kubelet API. Kubectl commands using manually extracted service account tokens. SIEM: mass pod listing or exec requests from a single IP.
defense.artifacts: API server audit log (anonymous access attempts) | Kubelet log (exec requests) | Network: connections to port 10250 from outside cluster
defense.prevention: Disable Kubelet anonymous authentication: set authentication.anonymous.enabled=false in kubelet config. Enable RBAC and ensure no ClusterRoleBindings grant excessive permissions to service accounts. Restrict access to ports 6443 and 10250 via network policy / firewall. Audit RBAC permissions regularly.
defense.misconfiguration: Kubelet API accessible on port 10250 without authentication (anonymous=true, webhook.enabled=false). Service accounts have overbroad ClusterRole bindings allowing pod creation and exec.
defense.vulnerable_config:
# Vulnerable kubelet config
authentication:
  anonymous:
    enabled: true  # allows unauthenticated access
  webhook:
    enabled: false

# Overly permissive ClusterRoleBinding
kind: ClusterRoleBinding
subjects:
  - kind: ServiceAccount
    name: default
roleRef:
  name: cluster-admin
defense.secure_config:
# Secure kubelet config
authentication:
  anonymous:
    enabled: false
  webhook:
    enabled: true
authorization:
  mode: Webhook

# Restrict ClusterRoleBindings
# Use least-privilege roles for service accounts
# Firewall: block 10250 from external IPs
